definition: an atom or molecule that carries an electric charge because it has gained or lost one or more electrons

collocations.example: Chlorine typically forms a negatively charged ion in solution.
The water filter uses ion exchange to remove minerals.

definition: a unit of frequency equal to one million hertz, often used to measure processor or radio speed

collocations.example: Early computers ran at only hundreds of megahertz.
Radio frequencies are usually measured in megahertz on this dial.

definition: a short daily meeting where a team reviews progress and plans the day's work

collocations.example: We start each day with a short daily scrum.
All developers must attend the scrum before starting their tasks.

definition: the feeling of not being able to believe that something is true or real

collocations.example: He shook his head in disbelief at the news.
A look of disbelief crossed her face during the speech.

definition: a tiny particle in the nucleus of an atom that carries no electric charge

collocations.example: Astronomers detected signals from a distant neutron star last year.
The number of neutrons determines which isotope you have.

definition: to defend yourself against a blow or a difficult question by turning it aside

collocations.example: The minister tried to parry a question about the scandal.
She can skillfully parry criticism during tense press conferences.

definition: a scented liquid, lighter than perfume, that people put on their skin to smell pleasant

collocations.example: He likes to wear cologne when he goes out.
She bought him an expensive bottle of cologne for his birthday.

definition: to take action in order to prevent something from happening or to stop someone else acting first

collocations.example: The company issued a statement to preempt criticism.
Regulators may move to preempt further damage to investors.

definition: a stringed musical instrument like a violin but slightly larger and lower in sound

collocations.example: She learned to play the viola at a young age.
The concert opened with a beautiful viola solo.
